content.title: Portals - Bridge to a United Planet
content.text: We are all creating the Portals artwork together - one story_at a timeContact usIn the collective consciousnessPortals are technology art sculptures. They connect to a network of identical sculptures all over the planet. Each Portal is located in the public space, providing a real-time, unfiltered livestream 24/7 that is frequently rotating between different Portal locations on Earth.We all share more than what separates usIn a world of increasingly polarizing narratives, it is essential to remember that we are all together on this tiny, beautiful spaceship called Earth.Expanding our definition of homePortals are an invitation to meet fellow humans above borders and prejudices and to experience our home – planet Earth – as it really is: united and one.historyConceived in 2016, the first Portals were developed under the direction of the Benediktas Gylys Foundation. After their debut in Vilnius and Lublin in 2021 - touching millions of hearts worldwide - Portals Organization was incorporated to build on this foundation and expand the Portals Network to all countries of planet Earth.learn moreit's oneExpanding into large cities and little towns around the world, Portals is an alive and constantly growing network. While each Portal is an individual sculpture, together they exist as one entity. portal locationshost a portalContact our team to learn more about hosting a Portal in your city.Announcing soonLithuaniaAnnouncing soonlatest newsPortals OrganizationHeadquartered in Vilnius and Berlin, Portals Organization is responsible for the development, fabrication and upkeep of the global Portals artwork.
